about_the_game:
Unlocks more than 25 new visual elements and in-game animations, allowing you to stand out on the map and during interactions with other countries. Yes, all the other players will see your armies in the new, fancy, and amazing style.

Choose animations for various types of troops: artillery, tanks, cruisers, battleships, aircraft carriers, chemical and nuclear attacks. You can select styles from the Steampunk, Hi-Tech Militarism, and Firestarter sets.

Signatures and name colors let you stand out in chat, player lists, and leave a unique signature when sending diplomatic actions to other countries.

To activate the visuals and animations, open the Customize window from the game's main menu.

P.S. Your purchase helps the developers continue improving the game. Thank you for your support!
